item.title: Contributing
item.description: Contributing to Gorai Thank you for your interest in contributing! Here’s how to get started. Ways to Contribute Bug reports — Found a bug? Open an issue Feature requests — Have an idea? Start a discussion Documentation — Improve docs, fix typos Code — Fix bugs, implement features Development Setup 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/gorai/gorai.git cd gorai # Install dependencies go mod download # Run tests go test .
